claim: petdex has 3,686 stars and a live submission queue of hand-drawn sprite pets — including a steady stream of Chinese submissions and an IP-holder takedown request — but every one of those pets can only be seen inside a coding-agent terminal. The 桌宠 audience it borrows from has had nothing new since Shimeji.
method: Read the petdex submission tracker rather than the star count: the open issues are ordinary people uploading their own drawn creatures (one titled 「[Submit fail] 宇智波佐助」) and a rights-holder asking for two entries to be withdrawn. Volume of user-drawn art plus an IP dispute, four months in, is behaviour evidence that the drawing half of this is already happening. Then checked the radar index — 桌宠 appears zero times across 567 entries.
hook: People are already drawing sprite creatures and uploading them by the hundred — and the only place to put one is a terminal window that their kid, their mum and everyone else they would show it to will never open.
does: petdex is a public gallery of animated pixel pets for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and Gemini CLI: submit a spritesheet, it becomes a creature that lives in a developer's terminal. The submission pipeline, moderation queue and IP fight are all real and running.
edge: The drawing-to-animated-companion pipeline has quietly been proven by strangers doing it for free — what is missing is the window it lives in.
why_use: The desktop-companion tradition (Shimeji, 桌宠) kept a large non-technical audience for a decade on abandoned freeware. Nobody has shipped a modern one, and now a child's drawing can become the sprite.
gap: The pets are trapped in developer terminals; no consumer-facing desktop pet product exists for the 桌宠 audience since Shimeji.
counter: Desktop pets have been free for fifteen years, so charging for one is unproven and the ceiling may simply be zero. It is also novelty with a short half-life: the joke fades, whoever owns the desktop can ship their own, and petdex's own tracker shows the real cost of a user-submitted gallery — issue #651 is a rights-holder demanding two pets be withdrawn, which is the first of many.
differentiator: Take the pipeline, drop the terminal, and make the input a drawing rather than a spritesheet. One photo of a child's drawing in, an animated companion out, living on Windows and macOS and reacting to what is actually on screen — head down while you type, looks up when a video starts. Sell it as a keepsake, not a utility: the creature your kid drew, alive on your desktop, exportable as a sticker pack. Cold start (Chinese): 小红书 and B站 搜「桌宠 自制」 and the Shimeji tutorial comment sections, which are full of people who gave up halfway; Cold start (English): r/Shimeji and r/desktops.
value: A parent, or anyone who wants company on the screen — a one-off purchase per creature, priced like a print, not a subscription.
risk: There is no verified first-hand complaint here yet, only behaviour: people submitting art. If the desktop-pet audience turns out to be nostalgic rather than paying, the whole thing is a charming zero.
consumer_angle: A desktop pet app for ordinary users, letting them adopt and display these pixel pets on their desktop, with a gallery and submission system.

voices.quote: 这两个条目属于同一公开品牌 IP 的历史提交，当前不再属于授权发布集

zh.claim: petdex 3686 星，还有一个活着的投稿队列，里面全是手画的像素宠物——包括源源不断的中文投稿，和一封版权方的下架函。但这些宠物只能在 coding agent 的终端里被看见。而它借来的那一脉受众——桌宠——自 Shimeji 之后再没有新东西。
zh.hook: 人们已经在成百上千地画像素小生物往上传了——而唯一能放它的地方，是一个他孩子、他妈、以及所有他想给看的人这辈子都不会打开的终端窗口。
zh.does: petdex 是给 Codex / Claude Code / OpenCode / Gemini CLI 用的公开动画像素宠物画廊：传一张精灵表，它就变成住在开发者终端里的一只小生物。投稿流水线、审核队列、版权纠纷，全都是真的在跑的。
zh.gap: 只有极客看得见。能力、画的流水线、受众三样都在，但分在三个地方：宠物住在终端里；想要屏幕上有个伴的人在普通的 Windows 和 macOS 上；而最新的那件事——一张手画的图直接生成整套动画精灵表——两边都没接上。
zh.counter: 桌宠已经免费了十五年，为它收费是件没被验证过的事，天花板可能干脆就是零。它还是个半衰期很短的新鲜感：梗会过去，握着桌面的那一方可以自己发一个；而 petdex 自己的 issue 区已经显示出用户投稿画廊的真实成本——#651 是版权方要求撤下两只宠物，这只是第一封。
zh.differentiator: 拿走流水线，扔掉终端，并且把输入从精灵表换成一张画。孩子的一张涂鸦拍进去，出来一个动画伴儿，住在 Windows 和 macOS 上，会对屏幕上正在发生的事做反应——你打字时它趴着，一开视频它抬头。按纪念品卖，不按工具卖：你家孩子画的那只，活在你的桌面上，还能导成一套贴纸。冷启动（中文）：小红书、B站搜「桌宠 自制」以及 Shimeji 教程下的评论区，挤满做到一半放弃的人；冷启动（英文）：r/Shimeji 与 r/desktops。
zh.value: 一个家长，或者任何想让屏幕上有个伴的人——按只买断，定价像买一张画，不是订阅。
zh.risk: 这里还没有一条经过验证的一手抱怨，只有行为：人们在投稿。如果桌宠受众只是怀旧而不掏钱，整件事就是一个可爱的零。
zh.why_use: 桌面伴侣这一脉（Shimeji、桌宠）靠着一批停止维护的免费软件，养住了十年的非技术受众。没人做过一个现代的，而现在，孩子的一张画就能变成那只精灵。
zh.edge: 「画 → 会动的伴儿」这条流水线，已经被一群陌生人免费替你验证过了——缺的只是它该住进去的那扇窗。

pick_reason: Verified demand via active submissions and IP takedown, clear gap in consumer desktop pets, and a solo founder can build a desktop wrapper and gallery.
